style: Retro-futuristic cabaret pop and vaudeville novelty arrangement. [HARMONY SYSTEM] Modal drone harmony with barbershop voice leading, non-diatonic cluster rubs, and quartal suspensions. [MELODIC SYSTEM] Fast scat contour with yodel register flips and chromatic cabaret patter. [RHYTHMIC SYSTEM] Swinging triplets invading a frantic waltz pulse with stop-start pauses. [TIMBRE / ATMOSPHERE SYSTEM] Upright bass, brushed percussion, fuzz guitar, cheap organ, and room bleed. [PERFORMANCE ATTITUDE] Ecstatic theatricality delivered with deadpan administrative precision. [ANCHOR / INVARIANT] A rhythmic walking bassline that holds firm while upper layers fracture. [OPERATORS] Hold bassline fixed while upper harmony migrates; compress triplet subdivision while stretching vocal breath; make organ swells behave like liquid geometry; preserve the waltz meter while destabilizing the melodic pitch centers; force incompatible temporal scales to coexist in tight syncopation.
lyrics: [SCENE START: THE PARLOR AT THE EDGE OF GEOMETRY] [TEMPO: FAST WALTZ] [INSTRUMENTATION: UPRIGHT BASS, BRUSHED SNARE, CHEAP ORGAN] [VERSE 1] The geometry is leaking down the hallway again. [PULSE RATE: THREE HUNDRED GALLONS PER PARSEC] Measure the angles where the rug meets the wall. A polygon has too many corners to hold liquid properly. [SPOKEN DEADPAN] It spilled into the vestibule. [SCAT VOCALS: BIP-BOP ZEE-BIP ZOOP] [PRE-CHORUS] [VOICE 1: TIGHT BARBERSHOP HARMONY] Who left the lid unlatched? Who forgot to screw the vertices down tight? [VOICE 2: SHIFTING MODAL DRONE] The hypotenuse is soggy. The perimeter is dripping on the floor. [YODEL REGISTER FLIP: YODEL-AY-EE-O] [CHORUS] [FULL ENSEMBLE: ECSTATIC THEATRICALITY] Drink the tesseract! Drink the four-dimensional draught! It tastes like rhombus and smells like pi! [RHYTHMIC HANDCLAPS] One, two, three, four-ish! Tilt the polyhedron until the corners puddle in your cup! [SCAT PERCUSSION: RICKY-TICKY TACK-TACK] [VERSE 2] [UPRIGHT BASS WALKING FAST] The room is shrinking through its fourth coordinate. The wallpaper is sweating non-Euclidean dew. [FAST CABARET PATTER] We checked the plumbing with a slide rule made of butter. We measured the volume of a yesterday afternoon. [SUDDEN DYNAMIC DROPOUT] It came out to seven gallons of blue astonishment. [WHISPERED ENSEMBLE] Do not look directly at the missing corner. [BRIDGE] [ORGAN SWELLS WITH NON-DIATONIC CLUSTER RUBS] [HOCKETED SYLLABLES SPLIT ACROSS VOICES] Clip it. Slice it. Fold the flat plane into a drinking horn. [POLYPHONIC COUNTERPOINT] When the sides collapse inward, catch the juice in a bucket of pure logic. [ACCELERATION: ROLLED CONSONANTS TR-TR-TR-TR] Pour it down the throat of the algorithm until it hiccups a straight line. [CHORUS] [FULL ENSEMBLE: MAXIMUM ENERGY] Drink the tesseract! Drink the four-dimensional draught! It tastes like rhombus and smells like pi! [RHYTHMIC HANDCLAPS] One, two, three, four-ish! Tilt the polyhedron until the corners puddle in your cup! [OUTRO] [SPATIAL THROWS AND ABRUPT REVERB DROPOUTS] [DEADPAN SPOKEN] The glass is empty. The tesseract has gone home to sleep under the bed. [SINGLE UPRIGHT BASS PLUCK] [SILENCE]
caption: A frantic vaudeville cabaret novelty where a multi-dimensional geometric shape has been transformed into an impossible beverage. Driven by swinging waltz pulses, modal barbershop vocal harmonies, rapid scat patter, and a relentlessly steady upright bass, the arrangement collapses spatial logic into absurd, high-energy theatrical performance.
